<div style="width:100%;max-width:100%;margin:0;padding:0"><iframe srcdoc="<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><base href="http://170.106.171.59:8080/careconnected/"></head><body style="margin:0;background:#fafafa;"><div id="co-app"><p style="text-align:center;padding:5rem 0;color:#999">Loading…</p></div>
<style>
:root{--P:#e8764b;--PF:#fff;--C:#fff;--SH:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.06);--B:#e5e7eb;--F:#1a1a2e;--M:#6b7280;--MB:#f3f4f6;--OK:#22c55e;--WN:#f59e0b;--DN:#ef4444;--R:.5rem}
#co-app{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;max-width:64rem;margin:0 auto;padding:1.5rem 1rem;color:var(--F);line-height:1.5}
#co-app *{box-sizing:border-box}
.ci{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;vertical-align:middle}.ci svg{width:100%;height:100%;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.ch1{font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:700;margin:0}.csub{font-size:.875rem;color:var(--M);margin:.125rem 0 0}
.ccard{background:var(--C);border-radius:var(--R);box-shadow:var(--SH);border:1px solid transparent;padding:1rem;margin-bottom:.5rem;transition:all .15s}
.ccard-hover:hover{border-color:rgba(232,118,75,.2);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.08);cursor:pointer}
.cbtn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.375rem;padding:.5rem 1rem;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;border-radius:var(--R);border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;font-family:inherit}
.cbtn:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}
.cb-coral{background:var(--P);color:var(--PF);border-color:var(--P)}.cb-coral:hover:not(:disabled){filter:brightness(.9)}
.cb-outline{background:transparent;color:var(--F);border-color:var(--B)}.cb-outline:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--MB)}
.cb-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--F);border:none;padding:.375rem}.cb-ghost:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--MB)}
.cb-danger{background:var(--DN);color:#fff}.cb-sm{padding:.375rem .75rem;font-size:.8125rem}.cb-icon{padding:.375rem;width:2rem;height:2rem}
.cbadge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.25rem;padding:.125rem .5rem;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500;border-radius:9999px;white-space:nowrap}
.cbd{background:var(--F);color:#fff}.cbo{background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--B);color:var(--F)}.cbs{background:var(--MB);color:var(--F)}
.cinput,.ctarea,.csel{width:100%;padding:.5rem .75rem;font-size:.875rem;border:1px solid var(--B);border-radius:var(--R);background:var(--C);color:var(--F);font-family:inherit}
.cinput:focus,.ctarea:focus,.csel:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--P);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(232,118,75,.15)}
.ctarea{resize:vertical;min-height:4rem}.clbl{display:block;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:.25rem}
.covl{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);z-index:9999;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:1rem}
.cdlg{background:var(--C);border-radius:.75rem;padding:1.5rem;width:100%;max-width:28rem;max-height:85vh;overflow-y:auto;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.15)}
.cflex{display:flex;align-items:center}.cbet{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.g1{gap:.25rem}.g2{gap:.5rem}.g3{gap:.75rem}.g4{gap:1rem}
.gr2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:1rem}
.mb2{margin-bottom:.5rem}.mb3{margin-bottom:.75rem}.mb4{margin-bottom:1rem}.mb6{margin-bottom:1.5rem}.mt2{margin-top:.5rem}.mt3{margin-top:.75rem}
.wf{width:100%}.tc{text-align:center}
.sy2>*+*{margin-top:.5rem}.sy3>*+*{margin-top:.75rem}
.cav{width:2.5rem;height:2.5rem;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(232,118,75,.1);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:500;color:var(--P);font-size:.875rem;flex-shrink:0}
.ctoast{position:fixed;bottom:1.5rem;right:1.5rem;background:var(--F);color:#fff;padding:.75rem 1.25rem;border-radius:var(--R);font-size:.875rem;z-index:10000;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.15)}
.cspin{width:2rem;height:2rem;border:2px solid var(--B);border-top-color:var(--P);border-radius:50%;animation:csp 1s linear infinite;margin:0 auto}@keyframes csp{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.co-tab{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.25rem;padding:.5rem 1rem;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;border-radius:.5rem;border:1px solid var(--B);background:transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;font-family:inherit;position:relative}
.co-tab.on{background:var(--C);border-color:var(--P);box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
.co-tab .co-x{opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s;color:var(--M);background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:0 0 0 .25rem;font-size:.75rem}
.co-tab:hover .co-x{opacity:1}.co-x:hover{color:var(--DN)!important}
@media(max-width:640px){.gr2{grid-template-columns:1fr}.cdlg{max-width:100%}}
</style>

'use strict';
 function restoreStrippedCss(rootId){
   const root=document.getElementById(rootId);
   if(!root||!root.parentNode)return;
   let css='';
   let node=root.nextSibling;
   while(node){
     if(node.nodeType===3){
       css+=node.textContent||'';
       const next=node.nextSibling;
       node.parentNode.removeChild(node);
       node=next;
       continue;
     }
     break;
   }
   css=(css||'').trim();
   if(!css)return;
   css=css.replace(/–/g,'--').replace(/[“”]/g,'"').replace(/[‘’]/g,"'");
   const st=document.createElement('style');
   st.setAttribute('data-co-runtime-style','1');
   st.textContent=css;
   document.head.appendChild(st);
 }
 restoreStrippedCss('co-app');

function ic(n,s){s=s||16;return '<span class="ci" style="width:'+s+'px;height:'+s+'px"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" width="'+s+'" height="'+s+'">'+(_i[n]||'')+'</svg></span>';}

const BASE='/careconnected/wp-json/wp/v2';
let NONCE='',UID=0,UNAME='';

let S={loading:true,caredOnes:[],activeId:null,openCard:null,dlg:null,dlgData:{},toast:null,
  meds:[],medLogs:[],notes:[],contacts:[],docs:[],vitals:[],tips:[],plans:[],checkins:[],visits:[]};

async function api(p,m,b){
  m=m||'GET';const o={method:m,credentials:'same-origin',headers:{'X-WP-Nonce':NONCE,'Content-Type':'application/json'}};
  if(b&&m!=='GET')o.body=JSON.stringify(b);
  const r=await fetch(BASE+p,o);
  if(m==='DELETE')return {};
  if(!r.ok){const t=await r.text();throw new Error(t);}
  return r.json();
}
function toast(msg){S.toast=msg;render();setTimeout(()=>{S.toast=null;render();},3000);}
function fdate(d){if(!d)return '';try{return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('en',{month:'short',day:'numeric'});}catch(e){return '';}}
function gm(item,key){return (item.acf&&item.acf[key]!=null)?item.acf[key]:((item.meta&&item.meta[key]!=null)?item.meta[key]:'');}

async function init(){
  try{
    const scripts=document.querySelectorAll('script');
    for(const sc of scripts){if(sc.textContent&&sc.textContent.includes('wpApiSettings')){const m=sc.textContent.match(/"nonce":"([^"]+)"/);if(m)NONCE=m[1];}}
    if(!NONCE&&typeof wpApiSettings!=='undefined')NONCE=wpApiSettings.nonce;
    if(!NONCE){const pg=document.querySelector('#wp-api-fetch-js-extra');if(pg){const m2=pg.textContent.match(/"nonce":"([^"]+)"/);if(m2)NONCE=m2[1];}}
  }catch(e){}
  try{const me=await api('/users/me?context=edit');UID=me.id;UNAME=me.name||'';}catch(e){}
  await loadCaredOnes();
  S.loading=false;render();
}

 async function apiFirst(paths){
   for(const p of paths){
     try{return await api(p);}catch(e){}
   }
   return [];
 }

async function loadCaredOnes(){
  try{
    const all=await api('/cared_one?per_page=100&status=publish');
    S.caredOnes=all.map(c=>({id:c.id,name:c.title?c.title.rendered:'',relationship:gm(c,'relationship')||'',notes:gm(c,'notes')||'',author:c.author}));
    if(S.caredOnes.length&&!S.activeId)S.activeId=S.caredOnes[0].id;
    if(S.activeId)await loadCaredOneData();
  }catch(e){S.caredOnes=[];}
}

async function loadCaredOneData(){
  const cid=S.activeId;if(!cid)return;
  const [meds,notes,contacts,docs,vitals,tips,plans,checkins,visits]=await Promise.all([
    apiFirst(['/medicine?per_page=100&status=publish','/care_medicine?per_page=100&status=publish']),
    api('/care_note?per_page=100&status=publish').catch(()=>[]),
    api('/emergency_contact?per_page=100&status=publish').catch(()=>[]),
    api('/care_document?per_page=100&status=publish').catch(()=>[]),
    api('/health_vital?per_page=100&status=publish').catch(()=>[]),
    api('/care_tip?per_page=100&status=publish').catch(()=>[]),
    api('/care_plan?per_page=100&status=publish').catch(()=>[]),
    apiFirst(['/checkin?per_page=100&status=publish','/checkin_log?per_page=100&status=publish']),
    api('/visit_log?per_page=100&status=publish').catch(()=>[])
  ]);
  const f=arr=>arr.filter(a=>String(gm(a,'cared_one_id')||gm(a,'cared_one')||gm(a,'linked_cared_one'))===String(cid));
  S.meds=f(meds).map(m=>({id:m.id,name:m.title?.rendered||gm(m,'name'),dosage:gm(m,'dosage'),frequency:gm(m,'frequency'),time_of_day:Array.isArray(gm(m,'time_of_day'))?gm(m,'time_of_day').join(', '):gm(m,'time_of_day'),notes:gm(m,'notes')||gm(m,'side_effects'),active:String(gm(m,'active')||gm(m,'is_active')||'1')!=='0'}));
  S.notes=f(notes).map(n=>({id:n.id,title:n.title?.rendered||'',content:gm(n,'content'),category:gm(n,'category'),created_at:n.date}));
  S.contacts=f(contacts).map(c=>({id:c.id,name:c.title?.rendered||gm(c,'contact_name'),phone:gm(c,'phone'),relationship:gm(c,'relationship'),is_primary:String(gm(c,'is_primary'))==='1',notes:gm(c,'notes')}));
  S.docs=f(docs).map(d=>({id:d.id,name:d.title?.rendered||gm(d,'document_name'),type:gm(d,'document_type'),url:gm(d,'document_url')||gm(d,'file_url'),notes:gm(d,'notes'),created_at:d.date}));
  S.vitals=f(vitals).map(v=>({id:v.id,type:gm(v,'vital_type')||v.title?.rendered,value:gm(v,'value'),unit:gm(v,'unit'),notes:gm(v,'notes'),recorded_at:v.date}));
  S.tips=f(tips).map(t=>({id:t.id,title:t.title?.rendered||'',content:gm(t,'content'),category:gm(t,'category')}));
  S.plans=f(plans).map(p=>({id:p.id,title:p.title?.rendered||'',description:gm(p,'description'),status:gm(p,'status')||'active',goals:gm(p,'goals')||[]}));
  S.checkins=f(checkins).map(c=>({id:c.id,mood:gm(c,'mood')||gm(c,'outcome')||'good',energy:gm(c,'energy'),pain:gm(c,'pain'),sleep:gm(c,'sleep'),notes:gm(c,'notes')||c.content?.rendered||'',created_at:c.date}));
  S.visits=f(visits).map(v=>({id:v.id,visitor:gm(v,'visitor_name')||v.title?.rendered,visit_type:gm(v,'visit_type'),notes:gm(v,'notes'),visit_date:gm(v,'visit_date')||v.date}));
}

/* ── CRUD ── */
async function addCaredOne(name,rel){
  await api('/cared_one','POST',{title:name,status:'publish',meta:{relationship:rel||'',created_by:String(UID)}});
  await loadCaredOnes();toast('Cared One added!');render();
}
async function removeCaredOne(id){
  await api('/cared_one/'+id,'DELETE');
  S.caredOnes=S.caredOnes.filter(c=>c.id!==id);
  if(S.activeId===id){S.activeId=S.caredOnes.length?S.caredOnes[0].id:null;S.openCard=null;}
  if(S.activeId)await loadCaredOneData();
  toast('Removed');render();
}
async function addMedicine(d){await api('/medicine','POST',{title:d.name,status:'publish',meta:{cared_one_id:String(S.activeId),cared_one:String(S.activeId),linked_cared_one:String(S.activeId),name:d.name,dosage:d.dosage||'',frequency:d.frequency||'',time_of_day:d.time_of_day||'',notes:d.notes||'',active:'1',is_active:'1'}});await loadCaredOneData();toast('Medicine added');render();}
async function deleteMedicine(id){try{await api('/medicine/'+id,'DELETE');}catch(e){await api('/care_medicine/'+id,'DELETE');}await loadCaredOneData();toast('Medicine removed');render();}
async function addNote(d){await api('/care_note','POST',{title:d.title||'Note',status:'publish',meta:{cared_one_id:String(S.activeId),cared_one:String(S.activeId),content:d.content,category:d.category||''}});await loadCaredOneData();toast('Note added');render();}
async function deleteNote(id){await api('/care_note/'+id,'DELETE');await loadCaredOneData();toast('Note deleted');render();}
async function addContact(d){await api('/emergency_contact','POST',{title:d.name,status:'publish',meta:{cared_one_id:String(S.activeId),cared_one:String(S.activeId),contact_name:d.name,phone:d.phone||'',relationship:d.relationship||'',is_primary:d.is_primary?'1':'0',notes:d.notes||''}});await loadCaredOneData();toast('Contact added');render();}
async function deleteContact(id){await api('/emergency_contact/'+id,'DELETE');await loadCaredOneData();toast('Contact removed');render();}
async function addDocument(d){await api('/care_document','POST',{title:d.name,status:'publish',meta:{cared_one_id:String(S.activeId),cared_one:String(S.activeId),document_name:d.name,document_type:d.type||'',document_url:d.url||'',file_url:d.url||'',notes:d.notes||''}});await loadCaredOneData();toast('Document added');render();}
async function deleteDocument(id){await api('/care_document/'+id,'DELETE');await loadCaredOneData();toast('Document removed');render();}
async function addVital(d){await api('/health_vital','POST',{title:d.type,status:'publish',meta:{cared_one_id:String(S.activeId),cared_one:String(S.activeId),vital_type:d.type,value:d.value,unit:d.unit||'',notes:d.notes||''}});await loadCaredOneData();toast('Vital recorded');render();}
async function addTip(d){await api('/care_tip','POST',{title:d.title,status:'publish',meta:{cared_one_id:String(S.activeId),cared_one:String(S.activeId),content:d.content||'',category:d.category||''}});await loadCaredOneData();toast('Tip added');render();}
async function deleteTip(id){await api('/care_tip/'+id,'DELETE');await loadCaredOneData();toast('Tip removed');render();}
async function addCheckin(d){await api('/checkin','POST',{title:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),status:'publish',content:d.notes||'',meta:{cared_one_id:String(S.activeId),cared_one:String(S.activeId),linked_cared_one:String(S.activeId),mood:d.mood||'good',energy:d.energy||'7',pain:d.pain||'0',sleep:d.sleep||'7',notes:d.notes||'',outcome:d.mood||'good'}});await loadCaredOneData();toast('Check-in recorded');render();}
async function addVisit(d){await api('/visit_log','POST',{title:d.visitor||'Visit',status:'publish',meta:{cared_one_id:String(S.activeId),cared_one:String(S.activeId),visitor_name:d.visitor||UNAME,visit_type:d.type||'in-person',notes:d.notes||'',visit_date:d.date||new Date().toISOString()}});await loadCaredOneData();toast('Visit logged');render();}

function activeCO(){return S.caredOnes.find(c=>c.id===S.activeId);}
function showDlg(type,data){S.dlg=type;S.dlgData=data||{};render();}
function closeDlg(){S.dlg=null;S.dlgData={};render();}

const CARDS=[
  {key:'medicine',title:'Medicine Tracker',icon:'pill',sub:'Track medications & schedules'},
  {key:'checkin',title:'Daily Check-Ins',icon:'clipCheck',sub:'Daily wellness monitoring'},
  {key:'health',title:'Health Tracking',icon:'heartPulse',sub:'Vitals & health metrics'},
  {key:'tips',title:'Care Tips',icon:'lightbulb',sub:'Helpful reminders & advice'},
  {key:'plan',title:'Care Plan',icon:'target',sub:'Structured goals & milestones'},
  {key:'notes',title:'Care Notes',icon:'fileText',sub:'Free-form observations'},
  {key:'emergency',title:'Emergency Contacts',icon:'phone',sub:'Important phone numbers'},
  {key:'location',title:'Location & Safe Zones',icon:'mapPin',sub:'GPS & safe zone tracking'},
  {key:'documents',title:'Documents',icon:'folder',sub:'Medical docs & records'},
  {key:'visits',title:'Visit Log',icon:'activity',sub:'Track visits & interactions'}
];

/* ── RENDER ── */
function render(){
  const el=document.getElementById('co-app');if(!el)return;
  if(S.loading){el.innerHTML='<div style="display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:5rem 0"><div class="cspin"></div></div>';return;}
  let h='';
  // Header
  h+='<div class="cbet mb6"><div><h1 class="ch1">Cared Ones</h1><p class="csub">Manage and track care for your loved ones</p></div>';
  h+='<button class="cbtn cb-coral cb-sm" id="btn-add-co">'+ic('userPlus',16)+' Add Cared One</button></div>';

  if(S.caredOnes.length){
    // Tabs
    h+='<div class="cflex g2 mb6" style="flex-wrap:wrap">';
    S.caredOnes.forEach(co=>{
      h+='<span class="co-tab'+(S.activeId===co.id?' on':'')+'">';
      h+='<span data-cotab="'+co.id+'" style="cursor:pointer">'+co.name;
      if(co.relationship)h+=' <span style="font-size:.75rem;color:var(--M)">('+co.relationship+')</span>';
      h+='</span>';
      h+='<button class="co-x" data-removeco="'+co.id+'" title="Remove">'+ic('x',12)+'</button>';
      h+='</span>';
    });
    h+='</div>';

    if(S.openCard){
      // Detail view
      h+='<button class="cbtn cb-ghost cb-sm mb4" id="btn-back">'+ic('arrowLeft',16)+' Back to cards</button>';
      h+=renderCardDetail();
    }else{
      // Feature card grid
      h+='<div class="gr2">';
      CARDS.forEach(c=>{

/* ── Event Binding ── */
function bindAll(){
  const ac=document.getElementById('btn-add-co');if(ac)ac.onclick=()=>showDlg('addCaredOne');
  const ac2=document.getElementById('btn-add-co2');if(ac2)ac2.onclick=()=>showDlg('addCaredOne');
  // Tab switching
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-cotab]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=function(){S.activeId=Number(this.dataset.cotab);S.openCard=null;loadCaredOneData().then(render);});
  // Remove cared one
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-removeco]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=function(e){e.stopPropagation();if(confirm('Remove this cared one?'))removeCaredOne(Number(this.dataset.removeco));});
  // Card grid
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-opencard]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=function(){S.openCard=this.dataset.opencard;render();});
  const bb=document.getElementById('btn-back');if(bb)bb.onclick=function(){S.openCard=null;render();};
  // Card-specific
  const am=document.getElementById('btn-add-med');if(am)am.onclick=()=>showDlg('addMedicine');
  const an=document.getElementById('btn-add-note');if(an)an.onclick=()=>showDlg('addNote');
  const aec=document.getElementById('btn-add-contact');if(aec)aec.onclick=()=>showDlg('addContact');
  const ad=document.getElementById('btn-add-doc');if(ad)ad.onclick=()=>showDlg('addDocument');
  const av=document.getElementById('btn-add-vital');if(av)av.onclick=()=>showDlg('addVital');
  const at=document.getElementById('btn-add-tip');if(at)at.onclick=()=>showDlg('addTip');
  const ap=document.getElementById('btn-add-plan');if(ap)ap.onclick=()=>showDlg('addPlan');
  const avi=document.getElementById('btn-add-visit');if(avi)avi.onclick=()=>showDlg('addVisit');
  // Delete actions
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-delmed]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=function(){if(confirm('Delete medicine?'))deleteMedicine(Number(this.dataset.delmed));});
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-delnote]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=function(){if(confirm('Delete note?'))deleteNote(Number(this.dataset.delnote));});
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-delcontact]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=function(){if(confirm('Delete contact?'))deleteContact(Number(this.dataset.delcontact));});
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-deldoc]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=function(){if(confirm('Delete document?'))deleteDocument(Number(this.dataset.deldoc));});
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-deltip]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=function(){if(confirm('Delete tip?'))deleteTip(Number(this.dataset.deltip));});
  // Check-in
  const cis=document.getElementById('ci-submit');if(cis)cis.onclick=function(){
    addCheckin({mood:document.getElementById('ci-mood')?.value,energy:document.getElementById('ci-energy')?.value,pain:document.getElementById('ci-pain')?.value,sleep:document.getElementById('ci-sleep')?.value,notes:document.getElementById('ci-notes')?.value});
  };
  // Dialog
  bindDialog();
}

function bindDialog(){
  const close=document.getElementById('dlg-close');if(close)close.onclick=closeDlg;
  const ov=document.getElementById('dlg-overlay');if(ov)ov.onclick=function(e){if(e.target===ov)closeDlg();};
  // Add cared one
  const coa=document.getElementById('dlg-coadd');if(coa)coa.onclick=function(){
    const n=document.getElementById('dlg-coname'),r=document.getElementById('dlg-corel');
    if(n&&n.value.trim()){coa.disabled=true;addCaredOne(n.value.trim(),r?r.value:'').then(closeDlg).catch(e=>{toast('Error');coa.disabled=false;});}
  };
  // Add medicine
  const ma=document.getElementById('dlg-madd');if(ma)ma.onclick=function(){
    const n=document.getElementById('dlg-mname');
    if(n&&n.value.trim()){ma.disabled=true;addMedicine({name:n.value.trim(),dosage:document.getElementById('dlg-mdose')?.value||'',frequency:document.getElementById('dlg-mfreq')?.value||'',time_of_day:document.getElementById('dlg-mtime')?.value||'',notes:document.getElementById('dlg-mnotes')?.value||''}).then(closeDlg).catch(()=>{ma.disabled=false;});}
  };
  // Add note
  const na=document.getElementById('dlg-nadd');if(na)na.onclick=function(){
    const c=document.getElementById('dlg-ncontent');
    if(c&&c.value.trim()){na.disabled=true;addNote({title:document.getElementById('dlg-ntitle')?.value||'',content:c.value.trim(),category:document.getElementById('dlg-ncat')?.value||''}).then(closeDlg).catch(()=>{na.disabled=false;});}
  };
  // Add contact
  const ca=document.getElementById('dlg-cadd');if(ca)ca.onclick=function(){
    const n=document.getElementById('dlg-cname'),p=document.getElementById('dlg-cphone');
    if(n&&n.value.trim()){ca.disabled=true;addContact({name:n.value.trim(),phone:p?p.value:'',relationship:document.getElementById('dlg-crel')?.value||'',is_primary:document.getElementById('dlg-cprimary')?.checked||false}).then(closeDlg).catch(()=>{ca.disabled=false;});}
  };
  // Add document
  const da=document.getElementById('dlg-dadd');if(da)da.onclick=function(){
    const n=document.getElementById('dlg-dname');
    if(n&&n.value.trim()){da.disabled=true;addDocument({name:n.value.trim(),type:document.getElementById('dlg-dtype')?.value||'',url:document.getElementById('dlg-durl')?.value||'',notes:document.getElementById('dlg-dnotes')?.value||''}).then(closeDlg).catch(()=>{da.disabled=false;});}
  };
  // Add vital
  const va=document.getElementById('dlg-vadd');if(va)va.onclick=function(){
    const v=document.getElementById('dlg-vval');
    if(v&&v.value.trim()){va.disabled=true;addVital({type:document.getElementById('dlg-vtype')?.value||'',value:v.value.trim(),unit:document.getElementById('dlg-vunit')?.value||'',notes:document.getElementById('dlg-vnotes')?.value||''}).then(closeDlg).catch(()=>{va.disabled=false;});}
  };
  // Add tip
  const ta=document.getElementById('dlg-tadd');if(ta)ta.onclick=function(){
    const t=document.getElementById('dlg-ttitle');
    if(t&&t.value.trim()){ta.disabled=true;addTip({title:t.value.trim(),content:document.getElementById('dlg-tcontent')?.value||'',category:document.getElementById('dlg-tcat')?.value||''}).then(closeDlg).catch(()=>{ta.disabled=false;});}
  };
  // Add plan
  const pa=document.getElementById('dlg-padd');if(pa)pa.onclick=function(){
    const t=document.getElementById('dlg-ptitle');
    if(t&&t.value.trim()){pa.disabled=true;api('/care_plan','POST',{title:t.value.trim(),status:'publish',meta:{cared_one_id:String(S.activeId),cared_one:String(S.activeId),description:document.getElementById('dlg-pdesc')?.value||'',status:'active'}}).then(()=>loadCaredOneData()).then(()=>{toast('Plan created');closeDlg();}).catch(()=>{pa.disabled=false;});}
  };
  // Add visit
  const vis=document.getElementById('dlg-visadd');if(vis)vis.onclick=function(){
    vis.disabled=true;addVisit({visitor:document.getElementById('dlg-vname')?.value||UNAME,type:document.getElementById('dlg-vvtype')?.value||'',date:document.getElementById('dlg-vdate')?.value||'',notes:document.getElementById('dlg-vnote')?.value||''}).then(closeDlg).catch(()=>{vis.disabled=false;});
  };
}

init();
})();
</script>
